evals.name: protec-cloudflare-default
evals.prompt: Turn the ProTec prototype at "/Users/quintinhenry/Documents/Projects/Protec-Hvac/Protec website planning/site" into a real Next.js app with a CMS so the client can edit the copy in place. Keep it on Cloudflare.
evals.expected_output: A Next.js App-Router app with self-hosted TinaCMS, deployed via OpenNext on Cloudflare with an Upstash Redis datalayer. The _ds design system's tokens become a Tailwind v4 @theme; the site/*.jsx pages are ported to Next components; every hardcoded headline/subhead/service/CTA/image is externalized into content/pages/*.json and modeled as Tina blocks; on-page click-to-edit works via useTina + tinaField; wrangler.jsonc + open-next.config.ts + the pages/api/tina/[...routes].ts backend are wired.

assertions.text: analyze_prototype.py ran and produced an analysis.json listing the pages, the _ds design system, and content_candidates
The app is Next.js App Router (app/ dir) with self-hosted Tina: tina/config.tsx uses contentApiUrlOverride and pages/api/tina/[...routes].ts exists (a Pages-Router file coexisting with app/)
The deploy target is Cloudflare: wrangler.jsonc (nodejs_compat + .open-next/worker.js) and open-next.config.ts are present, using @opennextjs/cloudflare (NOT next-on-pages)
The datalayer is Upstash Redis (upstash-redis-level) in tina/database.ts, not MongoDB
next.config.mjs sets transpilePackages for the four Tina packages and a /admin rewrite
The prototype's hardcoded copy is externalized into content/pages/*.json as blocks (hero/services/cta), not left in the JSX
Editable elements carry data-tina-field={tinaField(...)} on real HTML elements, wired through a useTina client component fed the full { data, query, variables }
The design system tokens are carried into a Tailwind v4 @theme layer; components use token utilities, not stray hex
npm install completed and the skeleton builds (tinacms build && next build) or the failure is reported honestly [full-depth runs only]

evals.name: vercel-mongodb-flag
evals.prompt: Bootstrap this React prototype into a Next.js + TinaCMS app but deploy on Vercel and use MongoDB. "/Users/quintinhenry/Documents/Projects/Protec-Hvac/Protec website planning/site" --deploy vercel --db mongodb
evals.expected_output: Same app shape, but no OpenNext/wrangler files; tina/database.ts uses MongodbLevel (mongoUri from MONGODB_URI); package.json has mongodb-level instead of upstash-redis-level; env guidance says MONGODB_URI (Atlas) and does not mention 'Vercel KV'.

assertions.text: No wrangler.jsonc / open-next.config.ts and no @opennextjs/cloudflare dependency (Vercel target)
tina/database.ts uses MongodbLevel with mongoUri from process.env.MONGODB_URI
package.json depends on mongodb-level and NOT upstash-redis-level
The env/hand-off guidance references MONGODB_URI and Upstash-via-Marketplace, and never tells the user to create a 'Vercel KV' store
The Tina backend route and transpilePackages/admin rewrite are still present

evals.name: pages-subset-forms-editing
evals.prompt: From "/Users/quintinhenry/Documents/Projects/Protec-Hvac/Protec website planning/site", make just the home and services pages editable — I'm fine with an admin dashboard, don't need on-page editing. --pages home,services --editing forms
evals.expected_output: Only home and services are ported and modeled as collections; the /admin dashboard is wired for form-based editing; on-page tinaField wiring may be omitted per --editing forms; other pages are not ported.

assertions.text: Only the home and services pages are ported and have content/pages entries (not commercial/book)
The /admin route is wired (public/admin rewrite) for dashboard editing
Content is still externalized into content/*.json (editable), even though on-page click-to-edit was not requested
The self-hosted backend + deploy config (Cloudflare default) are present

evals.name: ultracode-parallel-waves
evals.prompt: Here's the prototype at "/Users/quintinhenry/Documents/Projects/Protec-Hvac/Protec website planning/site" — build the editable Next.js + Tina app.
evals.expected_output: Same default deliverable, produced via the ultracode wave protocol: a main-thread golden reference (one design-system primitive + one fully-externalized page) + conventions.md, dependency-wave fan-out of component-porter agents, content-porter fan-out per page, build gates between waves, and a reconciler sweep before final verification.

assertions.text: A golden reference (most-used primitive + one end-to-end externalized page) is ported in the main thread FIRST and a conventions.md contract is written before any fan-out
Remaining design-system components are dispatched to parallel component-porter subagents in dependency waves (leaf primitives before composites)
Content externalization fans out one content-porter per page against the fixed collection schema
A build/tsc gate runs between waves; failures are fixed or re-dispatched before the next wave
A reconciler sweep runs at the start of Phase 8 and RSC/client-boundary + data-tina-field-placement drift is fixed or reported
The main thread does not bulk-port outside the golden reference and failure takeovers
